title: Na Bajde Ghoray Toun Ghazi Lendha
body:
Na Tauq Gaal Vich Sajjad Panda, Na Saar Bay Raina
Main Shaam Jaandi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jay Meray Ghazi Nu Tu Laaran Di,
Kaddi Ijazaat Hussain Denda (x2)
Na Kala Akbar Di Laash Chanda
Na Saar Bay Raina
Main Shaam Jaandi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jay Meray Ghazi Bhira Na Maarda,
Main Shaam Day Vich Kaddi Na Ruldi (x2)
Na Koyi Bhagi Di Bhain Aanda
Na Saar Bay Raina
Main Shaam Jaandi
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain Raye Meray Dil Ch’ Hasrat,
Main Teray Laashay Tay Vain Poundi (x2)
Na Jhirkaan Daykay Koyi Uthanda
Na Saar Bay Raina
Main Shaam Jaandi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dou Jag Da Mukhtaar Mera Abid
Kafan Sakina Da Maangreya Ay (x2)
Na Vakhri Oodhi Kabar Banada
Na Saar Bay Raina
Main Shaam Jaandi.
